subject: Energy
title: The Decline of Coal
description: A quick win: understand The Decline of Coal.

hook.text: Coal consumption has peaked in many countries—cheaper gas and renewables are steadily replacing it.

buildup.text: The UK burned its last coal for electricity in 2024—the country that started the coal age ended its own.

discovery.text: Coal plants emit twice the CO₂ of gas plants per unit of electricity—making them climate policy targets.

twist.text: But global coal use is still rising overall—China and India are building new plants to meet growing demand.

climax.text: Coal still generates about 35% of world electricity—the transition away from it will take decades.

punchline.text: Coal is dying in the West—but very much alive elsewhere.

quiz.question: Which country burned its last coal for electricity in 2024?
